general_tools.name: submit_report
general_tools.description: Save or update structured intake for the case bound to this call. Preserve an existing upstream priority; report facts without diagnosis. A saved report does not verify an incident or notify responders.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this intended mutation within this call, for example report-1 or readback-v2-1. Reuse the same identifier and identical arguments only when retrying that mutation. Use a new identifier for a new intended action.

summary.description: A short factual summary based on caller-confirmed details. Distinguish a caller report from verified information. Preserve relevant previously saved needs.

resident_name.description: Only a name the caller supplied or the supplied resident_name; omit when it is already saved. Do not collect identifiers unnecessarily.

language.description: The caller's selected language: en for English or es for Spanish.

zone.description: Only a zone or location label supplied by the caller or operator context. Omit if unknown.

category.description: The supplied upstream category or a plain topic label from the caller's report. This does not diagnose or verify the incident.

severity.description: Copy the supplied upstream priority only. Never lower it or invent a new classification. If urgency is unclear or new danger is reported, request human review promptly while preserving the supplied label.

triage_source.description: Copy the actual supplied classification source when known. Omit when unknown. Do not invent a model, agency, reviewer, or voice-side classification source.

skills_needed.description: Only relevant support skills from the supplied case or caller's confirmed needs, such as mobility, logistics, medical, or safety.

needs_assistance.description: True when the caller requests help or a human. A false answer does not close an already active help request.

assistance_details.description: Caller-confirmed help needed, preserving useful context already saved. Do not invent dispatch, assignment, or completion.

location.description: Only location details voluntarily supplied and needed for the request. Do not guess an address or coordinates.

hazard_here_now.description: Only an explicit caller statement about whether the reported hazard is present at their location now. This is reported, not independently verified.

people_at_risk.description: Only an explicit count reported by the caller. Omit if unknown.

vulnerability.description: Only explicitly reported support needs, such as mobility. Do not infer a diagnosis from speech.

general_tools.name: lookup_guidance
general_tools.description: Look up the current operator-approved notice and its exact version for the case bound to this call. Use it before reading an instruction. If none is available, request operator help; do not invent guidance.

language.description: The caller's selected language, matching the configured en or es call.

general_tools.name: save_checkin
general_tools.description: Save an explicit caller read-back against the notice version actually read. This records communication and any assistance need independently; it does not prove safety or complete a request.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this intended mutation within this call, for example report-1 or readback-v2-1. Reuse the same identifier and identical arguments only when retrying that mutation. Use a new identifier for a new intended action.

notice_version.description: Exact version returned by lookup_guidance for the instruction the caller actually heard. Never substitute a newly revised version for the old instruction.

action_key.description: Use the returned notice action_key only if the caller explicitly read back that action correctly. For a wrong, missing, or ambiguous answer, use unconfirmed so the backend requires clarification. Never guess confirmation.

readback_text.description: The caller's actual relevant answer in their language. Do not replace it with a generated affirmation or the notice text.

needs_assistance.description: Whether the caller explicitly requested assistance. Omit when unanswered; never treat it as permission to close active assistance.

assistance_details.description: Caller-confirmed assistance details. Preserve the nature of any saved help need.

general_tools.name: check_status
general_tools.description: Read the recorded communication, help, and follow-up status of this call's bound case only. Do not treat requested, assigned, or accepted as completed or dispatched.

general_tools.name: route_to_human
general_tools.description: Record a request for human follow-up and return a responder recommendation for this call's case. It does not transfer or dial a phone, guarantee acceptance, or dispatch help.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this intended mutation within this call, for example report-1 or readback-v2-1. Reuse the same identifier and identical arguments only when retrying that mutation. Use a new identifier for a new intended action.

reason.description: Concise reason the caller needs a person, including language and relevant confirmed support needs. Do not invent an urgent finding.

general_tools.name: schedule_callback
general_tools.description: Record pending callback work requested by the caller for a non-P0 case. No call is scheduled with a provider and no response time is guaranteed. Never use this to defer an immediate danger or P0 case.

event_id.description: Stable identifier for this intended mutation within this call, for example report-1 or readback-v2-1. Reuse the same identifier and identical arguments only when retrying that mutation. Use a new identifier for a new intended action.

minutes.description: The caller's requested follow-up interval in minutes, from 1 to 60. This is a requested work-queue target, not a promise.

reason.description: Caller-confirmed reason for follow-up, with any relevant unmet need.
